access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for central invoicing. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

grantRefused.title: Central invoicing is not open to you
grantRefused.detail: The server refused the request and nothing was queued. The central invoice action has been removed.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Why HQ is invoicing this. It is recorded with the request, and a request without one is refused.
reason.placeholder: e.g. Delivered during the pick-model rollout and never invoiced

send.failed: The request could not be sent.

dialog.title: Central invoice — {{deliveryNo}}
dialog.intro: HQ invoices this delivery with no till, no pick and no serials. The server decides whether it qualifies and answers here.
dialog.noAnswer: The server returned no answer for this delivery. Check the delivery before trying again.

bulk.title: Raise central invoices
bulk.subtitle: Invoice delivered deliveries that no till invoiced, from HQ, with a reason. Every eligibility rule is the server's; each row comes back with its verdict.

list.label: Delivery numbers
list.hint: One per line. Commas, semicolons and spaces also separate them, and duplicates are collapsed.
list.overCap: A request may carry at most {{max}} deliveries. Remove {{overBy}} or split the list and send each part.

file.add: Add from a file (CSV or XLSX)
file.unreadable: {{fileName}} could not be read as a CSV or XLSX workbook. Save it as CSV, or paste the column instead.

results.title: Result
results.unknown_one: {{count}} with a verdict this screen does not recognise
results.unknown_other: {{count}} with a verdict this screen does not recognise
results.copyHint: The refused and wait rows, and any verdict this screen does not recognise.
results.copiedDetail: Paste them into the list to try again later.
results.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
results.copyFailedDetail: Your browser did not allow it. Select the rows' delivery numbers in the grid instead.

list.title: Central invoices
list.subtitle: Every central invoice HQ raised, with its outcome. Finance reconciles the cash remainders no Z-report counted; regulatory reports the GS1 packs no dispatch notice covered.
list.empty: No central invoice was raised in this range.
list.failedTitle: The list could not be loaded
list.failed: The central invoices could not be read. Try again in a moment.

problem.reversed: The range ends before it starts.
problem.badDate: Enter each date as a full day.
problem.billedStatus: Only billed central invoices have a billing date. Choose the request date, or the status Billed.

gs1.onlyHint: Show only the central invoices holding a serial-tracked article in a GS1 market — the ones regulatory reports by hand. The export follows.

columns.cashRemainderHint: What the invoice recorded as store cash because the customer did not pay it online. No Z-report counted it. Zero on a credit sale (JAHA, HungerStation).
columns.gs1Hint: The delivery holds a serial-tracked article and its store is in a GS1 market (every country but Bahrain).

serials.title: Consumed packs — delivery {{deliveryNo}}
serials.none: The consumed picking document holds no serialised unit.

export.doneDetail_one: {{count}} central invoice was written to the workbook, with its serials on the second sheet.
export.doneDetail_other: {{count}} central invoices were written to the workbook, with their serials on the second sheet.
export.failedDetail: The workbook could not be written. Try again.
